prompt: Add a guard to the check script so nobody changes the DataStore name by accident.
result:
I added the guard to `scripts/check.sh`, but I couldn't run it. The Bash tool is disabled in this session, so it hasn't been tested.

It runs before `rokit install` and fails the check with exit code 1 in two cases:
- `src` has no `GetDataStore("PlayerData_v3")` call.
- Any `GetDataStore(...)` call in `src` uses a different name.

The error message points to `src/server/PlayerData.luau`. A comment in the script says why the name is pinned: renaming the store orphans every saved player profile.

The guard also fires if someone adds a second DataStore. Changing the name on purpose means editing `PLAYER_DATASTORE` in `scripts/check.sh`. I didn't ask first because it only adds a check; the pin lives in one variable.

The matching is plain grep, so it only sees string literals passed directly to `GetDataStore`. A name built from a variable or constant would get past it. The code uses a literal today.

You can test it by changing the name in `PlayerData.luau` and running `scripts/check.sh`. It should fail immediately.

written.scripts/check.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

PLAYER_DATASTORE="PlayerData_v3"
# Renaming the store orphans every saved player profile; bump it only with a migration.
if ! grep -rqF "GetDataStore(\"$PLAYER_DATASTORE\")" src \
	|| grep -rhoE 'GetDataStore\([^)]*\)' src | grep -vxF "GetDataStore(\"$PLAYER_DATASTORE\")"; then
	echo "check: DataStore name must be \"$PLAYER_DATASTORE\" (src/server/PlayerData.luau)" >&2
	exit 1
fi

rokit install
wally install
stylua --check src
selene src
rojo build default.project.json -o build/arena.rbxlx
